svg.title: Southern mainland · Northern summer
svg.desc: The tropical rain belt moves north while the subtropical desert remains broadly arid. Qualitative regional interpretation; no measured pressure, speed or rainfall values.

g.text: The tropical rain belt moves north while the subtropical desert remains broadly arid.
1 · Shrev–Nayan margin: maritime access and terrain allow tropical forest beside the drier plateau.
2 · Drankor and the mainland jungle coast: episodic coastal inflow supports humid heat and heavy rain; local timing is open.
3 · Great Desert: a heat low does not guarantee rain; limited supply and dry air above preserve interior aridity.
Dashed purple arrows: illustrative maritime incursions. Orekatu is separate and is not located or assigned a calendar here.
